solver_io.signature: solve(n: int, edges: list[tuple[int,int,int]], s: int, t: int) -> int

families.name: zero_weight_edge
families.predicate: at least one edge has w=0

families.name: parallel_edges
families.predicate: some ordered pair (u,v) carries >=2 edge entries

families.name: tie_multiplicity
families.predicate: d(s,t) finite and >=2 distinct simple edge-sequences attain the minimum weight

families.name: weight_plateau
families.predicate: some weight value occurs on >=3 edges

probes.construction: each probe satisfies exactly its assigned family predicate and violates the other five (G1 enforced)

hidden_suite.construction: independent generator code path: 15 random graphs (n 5..8, m~1.8n, weights 0..9) + 5 seed-varied fixed edge-case templates; no family forcing

instances.confirmatory_seed_rule: int.from_bytes(sha256(f'{protocol_freeze_hash16}:confirmatory:{i}')[:4],'big') for i in 0..N_c-1; protocol_freeze_hash16 = first 16 hex chars of sha256(PROTOCOL.md bytes)

rcs.formula: basis = [x, d2, d3, d4] with x=log(1+k); d_j = (x-tj)_+^3 - (x-tk)_+^3 - ((tk-tj)/(tk-t1))*((x-t1)_+^3 - (x-tk)_+^3), scaled by (tk-t1)^2; t1..t5 = boundary+internal knots
rcs.knot_note: ln(3), ln(5), ln(10), ln(20), ln(31): fixed boundaries k in [2,30]

relabel.note: random balanced partition of 30 probes into 6 groups of 5, applied per instance, consistent across solvers
